title: Mini Clean Lash Lengthening Tubing Mascara
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Long-wearing✓ Lengthening✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A go-to mascara for everyday that tints, lengthens, and lifts lashes with no smudging.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, triclosan, and contains less than one percent synthetic fragrance. It is also vegan, gluten-free, and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Meet your go-to mascara for everyday. Designed to distribute the perfect amount of product, the defining brush lifts lashes while ensuring your look never clumps or flakes. The mascara is easy to remove with cleanser to protect your lashes from harmful pulling and removal techniques that most smudgeproof
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Comb through lashes, doing a little wiggle at the base to add thickness to your lash line.
-To remove, wash with cleanser and warm water.
Ingredients+
Water (Aqua/Eau), Acrylates/Ethylhexyl Acrylate Copolymer, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Wax, Hydrogenated Olive Oil Stearyl Esters, Acrylates Copolymer, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax (Copernicia Cerifera Cera/Cire de carnauba), Euphorbia Cerifera (Candelilla) Wax (Euphorbia Cerifera Cera/Cire de candelilla), Acacia Senegal Gum, PVP, Palmitic Acid, Alcohol, Stearic Acid, Tromethamine, Glycerin, Steareth-20, Cetearyl Alcohol, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Simethicone, Laureth-21, Steareth-2, Panthenol, Phenoxyethanol, Sodium dehydroacetate, Ethylhexylglycerin, Ethyl Hexanediol, Sodium Benzoate, Benzyl Alcohol, Tocopherol; may contain/peut contenir (+/-): CI 77491/CI 77492/CI 77499 (Iron Oxides), CI 77891 (Titanium Dioxide).
